answer: Each agent's kernel seeds a unique 14-line sonnet, one line per stop on a wandering 2.1 km route past 14 beacons. At each beacon the kernel signs its line with a GPS fix and timestamp; stops must land 90 seconds apart, the full walk taking at least 21 minutes, and the rhyme scheme must match the kernel seed or the line is rejected. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 real TPM kernels ($80 phones = $80,000) plus 1,000 walkers at $25 a day, and a 100 POA bond per kernel locked 30 days. Like a choir where every singer walks to their own pew and sings a verse only they know.
